⚠️ Flash Memory Protection
To prevent EEPROM/flash wear on your Luxtronik controller, parameters are only updated during active optimizations. Once the heat pump returns to idle, all modified parameters are automatically reverted to your defined default values below to ensure a safe operating state.

💡 Recommendation: It is highly recommended to enable this feature if you use the intelligent cycle optimization (hot water + heating) and/or the dynamic HUP control!
<b>Hybrid Mode: Modbus TCP</b><br>Use Mo:
Hybrid Mode: Modbus TCP
Use Modbus TCP to write volatile parameters (like target temperatures or SmartGrid) directly into the RAM without causing wear to the EEPROM flash memory. Sensor data is still reliably read via the native port 8889.

2. System Types: The ideal spread depends entirely on your heating system. Underfloor heating (FBH) typically requires 3 to 5 K, whereas traditional radiators often run optimally between 7 to 10 K.

By default, the Luxtronik controller tre:
By default, the Luxtronik controller treats heating and domestic hot water (DHW) cycles as separate operations. This adapter coordinates both runs so the compressor transitions seamlessly without unnecessary stop/start cycles.

➔ Trigger rule: If (DHW Target - DHW Actual) ≥ (DHW Hysteresis - 1.5 K), Heating Return ≤ Return Target, heating is enabled (no heating limit/off/vacation), and DHW is allowed within the next 25 minutes (no lock time), heating is gently pre-started by temporarily raising the heating parallel offset by Heating Hysteresis + 0.5 K (automatically reset once the compressor runs stably).
